title: Check yourself: From a business problem to the simplest pattern

questions.stem: Scenario: Harbor Mutual's loan officers need policy questions answered with citations, and separately need decline letters drafted from structured decision data. A vendor proposes a single autonomous multi-agent system for both jobs. Which design fits best?

options.text: The vendor's system, since both jobs work on documents and one shared platform is easier to run and to staff
options.says: Ruled out because "Documents in common are not an architectural argument".

options.text: One agent that holds every tool, plus a routing prompt that picks the task to perform
options.says: Ruled out because a single agent with every tool joins two risk profiles, and "two different shapes need two different structures".

options.text: Two parts: retrieval with a cited reply, plus a template-driven workflow for correspondence
options.says: The two jobs have different shapes, so each gets the cheapest structure that fits and its own measures.

options.text: One model tuned on both kinds of text, so that no outside lookup is needed at all
options.says: Ruled out because the first job needs the current policy text: "The answer needs outside facts or one action".

origin.section: Two small components can beat one clever system

questions.stem: Scenario: Greywell Insurance's sponsor says the claims project exists to cut handling time per claim on routine claims, measured against last quarter. Which pillar does the sponsor want served?

options.text: Transformation, a capability that did not exist before the project
options.says: Ruled out because transformation claims "Something that could not be done before", and routine claims were handled before.

options.text: Efficiency, the same output with less effort for each unit
options.says: Handling time per claim against a baseline is the efficiency pillar's measure.

options.text: Cost, the whole process priced lower than before
options.says: Ruled out because cost counts "tokens, review time and rework, not model price alone" per task, and the sponsor named time.

options.text: Performance service levels, agreed targets that are met
options.says: Ruled out because that pillar's measures are "95th percentile latency, availability, accuracy by case type".
